title: Trilateral Commission Mellon historical grant verification pass, 2026-08-08
summary: Same-depth historical donor verification using Mellon Foundation grant records and Rockefeller archival context.

evidence.observation: Mellon Foundation records a $150,000 general-support grant to the Trilateral Commission awarded October 6, 1976 for 36 months.
Mellon Foundation records a $165,000 general-support grant to the Trilateral Commission awarded June 6, 1985 for 36 months.

Mellon's 1976 grant page links additional Trilateral Commission grants for 1979, 1982, and 1992. Their official grant IDs resolve to 12431, 12589, and 15674, but those pages were not retrievable during this pass, so their amounts and purposes remain unresolved.

The Rockefeller Archive Center describes early Commission financing as Rockefeller seed money supplemented by sources including the Kettering and Ford Foundations, placing Mellon support within a broader historical foundation-funding environment without implying current funding.

gaps: Official Mellon pages for the linked 1979, 1982, and 1992 grants currently cache-missed, so exact amounts and purposes are unresolved.
Historical grants should be reconciled to the correct contemporary legal/regional recipient identity rather than automatically attached to the present-day U.S. EIN.
Ford, Kettering, and Rockefeller historical grant amounts remain to be extracted from primary grant files or annual reports.
caveats: Historical grant support does not establish current funding.
A grant does not establish control, coordination, policy capture, or agreement.
Recipient naming and legal identity can change over decades; preserve donor wording and award date before entity normalization.

provenance.method: official donor grant and archival-source verification

workflow.next_action: Recover official 1979, 1982, and 1992 Mellon grant details and extract Ford/Kettering/Rockefeller historical amounts from primary records.

notes: Mellon donor records directly verify $150,000 general support in 1976 and $165,000 general support in 1985, both 36-month awards.
Mellon's own related-grant links establish additional 1979, 1982, and 1992 Trilateral grant records, but amounts are intentionally left unresolved until the official pages can be read.
Historical donor relations must remain time-scoped and separate from claims about current funding.

classification_rules: Prefer donor-owned grant records for historical funding edges.
Record award date, amount, purpose, duration, and recipient wording exactly when available.
Do not backfill inaccessible grant amounts from secondary donor lists.
Do not turn historical funding into a current relation without current evidence.
Do not infer policy influence or coordination from a grant.
data.method: Reviewed Mellon Foundation donor-owned grant pages, resolved related Trilateral grant IDs, and compared the chronology with Rockefeller Archive Center funding context.
data.narrative_role: historical donor-side verification and provenance hardening
data.research_question: Which historical foundation funding edges can be verified directly from donor-owned records, and which amounts must remain unresolved?

findings.finding: Mellon Foundation awarded the Trilateral Commission $150,000 for general support on October 6, 1976 for 36 months.
Mellon Foundation awarded the Trilateral Commission $165,000 for general support on June 6, 1985 for 36 months.
Mellon's own grant database links additional Trilateral Commission grants in 1979, 1982, and 1992, but their amounts and purposes remain unresolved in this pass.
